comparison: Perfect agreement. Both identify C1, C2, and C18 as foundational, well-established claims about Ct biology that provide essential context. Both treat these as accepted background knowledge without question.
Perfect agreement. Both support claims C9, C62, C63 showing FtsK, PBP2, and PBP3 can form foci without MreB filaments (A22 treatment), refuting the prior MreB scaffold hypothesis (C31).

Perfect agreement. Both support claims C85-C89 showing mecillinam treatment reduces PBP2 and PBP3 foci while maintaining FtsK foci, demonstrating PBP2's transpeptidase activity is required for stable divisome association.

Perfect agreement. Both support claims C102 and C103 showing mecillinam treatment allows discrete PG foci/bars to persist but prevents conversion to rings, distinguishing PBP2's role in PG reorganization from initial synthesis.
Perfect agreement. Both support claims C44 and C51 showing fusion proteins do not cause growth defects (IFU assays), validating their use as reporters of endogenous protein behavior.

Perfect agreement. Both support claims C106 and C107 recognizing the novelty of the comprehensive analysis of divisome assembly order and PG organization, representing a significant advance over prior studies.

Strong agreement. Both support FtsK localization patterns (C4, C37-C43, C46). OpenEval emphasizes reproducibility and fusion protein validation (C53), while peer reviewers focus on the clear demonstration of foci at septum and base.

Strong agreement. Both support claims C5, C45, C46 showing FtsK accumulation at the base of secondary buds. OpenEval emphasizes this as evidence for nascent divisomes; peer reviewers accept the localization data without detailed interpretation.

Strong agreement. Both support claims C11, C100, C101, C122 showing A22 treatment prevents PG ring formation while allowing foci to persist, demonstrating MreB's specific role in PG reorganization rather than initial synthesis.

Strong agreement. Both support claims C90-C97 showing various PG intermediates in coccoid cells with polarized distribution. OpenEval includes C98 (ring formation timing) as uncertain; peer reviewers accept all PG labeling data without expressing uncertainty.

Strong agreement on major finding. Both strongly support that FtsK is early and essential for divisome assembly (C3, C8, C64-C66, C68-C70, C72, C74). Peer review also includes C75, C104, C105, C124 emphasizing FtsK's critical upstream role and effects on PG synthesis.

Strong agreement. Both support claims C6, C47-C50, C52 showing hybrid divisome/elongasome composition. OpenEval also includes C53-C55 on temporal ordering; peer reviewers accept the localization hierarchy data.

Agreement with different emphasis. OpenEval supports C7, C54, C55, C57 establishing temporal ordering with FtsK arriving earliest. Peer reviewers accept the broader localization hierarchy (C6, C47-C55) without specifically highlighting FtsK's earliest arrival.
Strong agreement. Both support the hierarchical relationship showing ftsK knockdown reduces PBP2 and PBP3 foci (C75, C78, C80). Peer reviewers also include C79, C81 on PBP2→PBP3 dependency.

Strong agreement. Both support claims C76, C77, C79, C81 showing pbp2 knockdown maintains FtsK but eliminates PBP3 foci, establishing the FtsK→PBP2→PBP3 hierarchy. Peer reviewers also include C78, C80.

Partial agreement. Both support C76, C77 showing FtsK persists when PBP2 is knocked down. OpenEval includes C79, C81 on PBP3 dependency; peer reviewers focus specifically on the FtsK upstream position.

Agreement with different scope. OpenEval supports C10, C55 on MreB's late recruitment based on quantification. Peer reviewers support broader claims (C10, C11, C100, C101, C122) including MreB's role in PG ring formation.

Agreement. Both support claims C116-C119 on MreC rings and FtsK not forming rings. OpenEval includes C120, C121 on angled orientation as uncertain; peer reviewers accept these as descriptive observations without questioning functional relevance.

Agreement. Both support claims C58, C59 on A22 treatment effects and morphology controls. OpenEval emphasizes validation that lysis doesn't bias toward coccoid cells; peer reviewers accept A22 controls more broadly (C58-C61).

Agreement. Both support claims C60, C61 on MreB diffuse localization and MreC foci reduction following A22 treatment. OpenEval emphasizes this validates MreB-independent divisome proteins; peer reviewers accept as control data.

Agreement on FtsK's critical role. OpenEval supports C104, C105 showing ftsK knockdown has dramatic effects on PG localization. Peer reviewers include these claims in broader support for FtsK as early and essential (C3, C8, C64-C75, C104, C105, C124).

Agreement. OpenEval supports C53 showing no statistical difference between endogenous FtsK and FtsK-mCherry localization. Peer reviewers implicitly accept this by not questioning fusion protein validity in their discussion of localization hierarchy.

Agreement. Both support claims C29-C31 as established prior findings. OpenEval treats C12-C36 as appropriate background citations; peer reviewers specifically note C29-C31 on MreB's proposed scaffold role as the hypothesis being refined/refuted.

Agreement. OpenEval supports C34 (among C12-C36) as established background from Ouellette et al. 2012. Peer reviewers explicitly accept C34 as established background motivating the study's focus on FtsK.

Agreement. OpenEval supports C123, C124 suggesting FtsK may functionally replace FtsZ in Ct. Peer reviewers include C124 in their strong support for FtsK as early and essential component of the divisome.

Disagreement on certainty. OpenEval rates C98 (PG ring formation timing) as UNCERTAIN, noting temporal relationships require time-lapse imaging. Peer reviewers accept all PG labeling data (C90-C98) as SUPPORTED without expressing this uncertainty.
OpenEval supports C82 connecting findings to prior work (Cox et al. 2020) on PBP2-PBP3 relationship. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for this specific citation claim.
OpenEval supports C108-C114 on FtsK sequence comparison and domain organization. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not discuss FtsK structural features.
OpenEval rates C115 (data collected but not shown on FtsK localization timing) as UNCERTAIN due to lack of access to supporting data. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.

OpenEval rates C120, C121 (angled orientation of protein foci) as UNCERTAIN, noting the functional relevance is unclear and speculative. Peer reviewers (R15) accept these as descriptive observations without questioning uncertainty.

OpenEval supports C125-C129 citing recent work on P. limnophila showing different divisome requirements. No corresponding peer review evaluation found; peer reviewers did not discuss comparative aspects with other organisms.

OpenEval rates C56 (interpretation of localization patterns as assembly stages) as UNCERTAIN, noting time-lapse imaging needed to confirm. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for this specific interpretive claim.
